name: Eggnog Cinnamon-Raisin Bread Pudding with Sugar Glaze

instructions.primary_message: Cut bread loaf into 1-inch cubes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Set out on the counter to dry out overnight. (Alternatively, if short on time, place baking sheet in a preheated 200°F oven for 30-35 minutes. Let cool completely.)
When the bread is dried out (and cooled), coat an 8-inch square baking dish with butter. Transfer bread cubes to the baking dish, spread out in an even layer, and set aside.
Place eggnog, eggs, vanilla, and cinnamon in a medium bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups eggnog
vanilla extract
½ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Pour egg mixture over the bread in the baking dish. Gently stir to coat, then cover the dish with aluminum foil and place in the fridge for a minimum of 1 hour and up to 12 hours.

When you're ready to bake the bread pudding, discard foil from baking dish and place in a cold oven. Preheat oven to 375°F; once the oven comes to temperature, bake the bread pudding for 30-40 minutes until golden brown on top and set in the middle. (Cover bread pudding with aluminum foil, if needed, for the last 10-15 minutes to prevent burning.) Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.
While the bread pudding is cooling, place sugar, yogurt, and vanilla in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the glaze.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup powdered sugar
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide bread pudding between plates and drizzle with glaze. Enjoy!
